text.insert: Processing prepares evidence in staging and publishes only at the authority boundary selected by source classification. Acceptance makes a coherent result visible, advances the knowledge revision, and records enough lineage to replay or audit the decision.

props.title: Source acceptance rules
rows: During a run when inputs are immutable
During sync; knowledge-only when upstream did not move
After the owning gate accepts the change

steps.text: Materialize learnings and observed attempts from typed evidence
Anchor reusable claims to current symbols, files, and source identities
Corroborate, merge, refute, or supersede without discarding contradictory evidence
Validate every evidence reference and output schema
Accept idempotently at the governing authority boundary
Record source, job, attempt, input revision, output revision, and trace lineage
Mark the job `succeeded` and advance the accepted knowledge revision

text.insert: `succeeded` means outputs were accepted and provenance was recorded. Historical claims are checked against the current checkout; missing anchors become stale rather than guessed. Later or better-supported evidence may supersede wording, while contradictory evidence remains addressable for refutation and audit. Cancellation never deletes knowledge accepted by an earlier job.
